preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 100000 for n in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case n is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((len(parts) == 1 and parts[0] == '-1') or (len(parts) == n and set(map(int, parts)) == set(range(n)) and all(int(parts[i]) + i == int(int(parts[i]) + i)**0.5**2 for i in range(n))) for n, parts in zip(test_cases, [line.split() for line in output_lines]))
postconditions.description: For each test case with input n, the output line is either '-1' (indicating no solution) or a sequence of n distinct integers from 0 to n-1 such that for every index i, the value p[i] + i is a perfect square.
